newsitem.title: USA: ThermoLase offer nets 5 mln shrs, $1.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: ThermoLase offer nets 5 mln shrs, $1.5 mln.

text.p: ThermoLase Corp said Tuesday that in a recent offering it received over 4.97 million of its shares and $1.54 million cash in exchange for newly issued units.

The company, a developer of laser-based hair removal systems, had offered shareholders the right to exchange one common share and $3 cash for each new unit, comprised of one common share and one redemption right.

Thermolase said it issued only 2,000,000 units instead of the planned 4.39 million, causing the number of new units to be prorated at 45.46305 percent. The result is that each tendering shareholder will receive about 45.46 units for each 100 units requested.
The units have been trading on the American Stock Exchange on a when-issued basis since April 3 and will begin trading in a regular manner on the American Stock Exchange on April 10.
